entries.title: SQL Injection
entries.description_general: User-controlled input reaches a SQL query without robust parameterization or query isolation.
entries.impact: An attacker can alter database queries, bypass logic, read sensitive records or modify application data depending on privileges.
entries.recommendation: Use parameterized queries, typed ORM bindings, strict input normalization and least-privilege database accounts.

entries.title: Cross-Site Scripting
entries.description_general: User-controlled content is rendered in the browser without context-aware output encoding or sanitization.
entries.impact: Successful exploitation can execute JavaScript in a victim session, steal tokens available to JavaScript or manipulate user actions.
entries.recommendation: Apply context-aware output encoding, sanitize HTML with a proven allowlist sanitizer, enforce CSP and avoid unsafe DOM sinks.

entries.title: Server-Side Request Forgery
entries.owasp: A01:2025 - Falla de control de acceso
entries.description_general: The server can be induced to initiate outbound requests to attacker-chosen or internal resources.
entries.impact: Impact can include internal service discovery, cloud metadata exposure, credential retrieval or pivoting to restricted networks.
entries.recommendation: Use strict outbound allowlists, block private/link-local ranges, disable redirects to disallowed hosts and isolate request brokers.

entries.title: Path Traversal and Local File Inclusion
entries.owasp: A01:2025 - Falla de control de acceso
entries.description_general: User-controlled file paths can escape the intended directory or include local files.
entries.impact: Attackers may read application secrets, source code, configuration files or operating system artifacts.
entries.recommendation: Normalize paths, enforce fixed base directories, reject traversal tokens and use opaque file identifiers instead of raw paths.

entries.title: Server-Side Template Injection
entries.description_general: Untrusted input is interpreted by a server-side template engine.
entries.impact: Depending on the template engine and sandbox, exploitation can lead to remote code execution or sensitive data exposure.
entries.recommendation: Never render user input as templates, disable dangerous template features and isolate rendering in a hardened sandbox.

entries.title: Command Injection
entries.description_general: User-controlled input reaches an operating system command interpreter.
entries.impact: An attacker can execute arbitrary commands in the application runtime context.
entries.recommendation: Avoid shell execution, pass arguments as arrays, validate strict allowlists and run services with least privilege.

entries.title: CORS Misconfiguration
entries.description_general: Cross-origin policy allows untrusted origins to read sensitive responses.
entries.impact: A malicious website may read authenticated API responses when credentials are allowed and origin validation is weak.
entries.recommendation: Use an exact allowlist of trusted origins, avoid wildcard origins with credentials and validate CORS per endpoint sensitivity.

entries.title: Missing or Weak Content Security Policy
entries.description_general: The application does not enforce a sufficiently restrictive browser content policy.
entries.impact: Weak CSP can increase the exploitability and impact of client-side injection flaws.
entries.recommendation: Define restrictive default-src, script-src, object-src, base-uri, frame-ancestors and form-action directives using nonces or hashes where needed.

entries.title: Missing HSTS
entries.description_general: The HTTPS service does not instruct browsers to enforce HTTPS on future requests.
entries.impact: Users may remain exposed to downgrade or stripping attacks on first or repeated visits.
entries.recommendation: Set Strict-Transport-Security with an appropriate max-age and includeSubDomains after confirming HTTPS coverage.

entries.title: Cookie Missing Security Flags
entries.description_general: Session or security-sensitive cookies lack browser-enforced protection flags.
entries.impact: Missing flags can increase exposure to session theft, cross-site request abuse or accidental transmission over cleartext.
entries.recommendation: Use Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax or Strict for sensitive cookies, and rotate sessions after authentication.

entries.title: Clickjacking
entries.description_general: The application does not prevent sensitive pages from being embedded in hostile frames.
entries.impact: An attacker can trick users into interacting with hidden or overlaid application controls.
entries.recommendation: Use CSP frame-ancestors and, where compatible, X-Frame-Options DENY or SAMEORIGIN for sensitive pages.

entries.title: Exposed Sensitive File
entries.description_general: A sensitive file, repository artifact or backup is reachable from the web root.
entries.impact: Exposure can reveal credentials, source code, internal endpoints or deployment secrets.
entries.recommendation: Remove sensitive files from web-accessible paths, block dotfiles and backups at the web server, and rotate any exposed secrets.

entries.title: Weak TLS Protocol or Cipher
entries.description_general: The TLS service allows deprecated protocols or cipher suites.
entries.impact: Weak transport security can enable downgrade attacks or reduce confidentiality guarantees.
entries.recommendation: Allow only TLS 1.2/1.3, prioritize AEAD/ECDHE suites and remove NULL, anonymous, export, RC4, DES/3DES and CBC legacy ciphers.

entries.title: JWT Validation Weakness
entries.owasp: A08:2025 - Fallos de integridad de software o datos
entries.description_general: JWT handling accepts weak algorithms, missing signature checks or unsafe key selection.
entries.impact: Attackers may forge tokens, escalate privileges or impersonate users.
entries.recommendation: Pin accepted algorithms, validate issuer/audience/expiration, protect signing keys and reject unsigned or weakly signed tokens.

entries.title: Broken Object Level Authorization
entries.owasp: A01:2025 - Falla de control de acceso
entries.description_general: The application exposes object identifiers without enforcing authorization on each object access.
entries.impact: An authenticated or unauthenticated attacker may access or modify another user's records.
entries.recommendation: Enforce object-level authorization server-side for every request and use indirect references where practical.
